scene_timeline.visual_description: Pioladitingancia enters a hallway holding a black hoodie with red rose embroidery, approaching Fatboy SSE.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Pioladitingancia: 'Yo Fatboy, I like this sweater. Who make it?'

scene_timeline.visual_description: Fatboy SSE tries to take the hoodie back, explaining it won't fit Pioladitingancia because he is too small.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Fatboy SSE: 'It can't fit you, you're a f***ing baby. Give me my sweater, man.'

scene_timeline.visual_description: Fatboy SSE repeatedly tells Pioladitingancia the brand is Fashion Nova while Pioladitingancia mispronounces it.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Fatboy SSE: 'Fashion Nova. Fashion Nova. Calm down. Fashion Nova.' Pioladitingancia: 'Catch Nova? Catch Nova?'

scene_timeline.visual_description: Fatboy SSE walks away into a room to escape the persistent questioning as Pioladitingancia follows him shouting.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Pioladitingancia: 'Okay bro, I like it! Catch Nova!' Fatboy SSE: 'Back up! I gotta go to the bathroom!'

parsed_output.overall_summary: In this comedic skit, creator Pioladitingancia discovers a stylish black hoodie with rose embroidery belonging to Fatboy SSE. Upon asking who made it, Fatboy SSE reveals it is from Fashion Nova, a brand Pioladitingancia expresses surprise at for having men's clothing. The humor stems from Pioladitingancia's high-energy reaction and his persistent mispronunciation of 'Fashion Nova' as 'Catch Nova' while chasing Fatboy SSE through the house.
